name: Cuberto
summary: Long, front-loaded transforms on cards and titles, one curve for all of them, an elastic overshoot on button icons, and a cursor that answers in 0.3s. The page is sparse and the motion delivers it.

tiers.label: work card preview drift on hover
title line rising out of its mask

honestyNote: Scripts ship GSAP, ScrollTrigger and Lenis, but window.gsap wasn't exposed, so any GSAP tweens and the smooth scroll itself aren't in these numbers. Only CSS transitions and animations were readable.
notes: Leaving a card runs the same 1.2s curve as arriving. No separate, faster exit tier was seen.

The icon curve's second control point sits at y = 4.56, so a short hop reads as a big spring. A 0.6s sibling at y = 5.56 runs on CTA buttons. The motion default README says nothing outside brycerambach.com overshoots; these are hover-only, so a scan at rest wouldn't see them.

fromNotes.label: statement curve
fromNotes.text: On 30 elements, and 0.8s on 20 more. Always on transform alone. Live on 2026-10-17: the same curve at 1.2s and 0.8s.

fromNotes.label: morph pair
fromNotes.text: On the one transform and border-radius pair. Live: the button ripple, at 0.5s.

fromNotes.label: opacity layer
fromNotes.text: Opacity on its own timing, 0.4s and 0.6s, separate from the move. Micro-feedback at 0.2s.

fromNotes.label: reduced motion
fromNotes.text: Ignored: zero prefers-reduced-motion blocks in the one stylesheet. Live on 2026-10-17 the CSS has one such query and a script asks matchMedia once, but 91% of movement still runs with it on. The verdict is the same; the zero is out of date.
